name: Deliberation & Technology (DelibTech) Network
tagline: International network of technologists and practitioners building and studying technology to enhance deliberation and digital infrastructure for deliberative democracy
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on AI & Democracy Foundation coordination; limited public funding transparency
curation_criteria: Invite-only membership; prioritizes functioning and geographic diversity; limited to two people per organization; members participate in virtual and in-person convenings under Chatham House rules
contributor_governance: Members invited as individuals; can suggest alternative participants; express interest mechanism for new members
ai_involvement: Yes - network focuses on AI-powered technologies in deliberative processes; coordinated by AI & Democracy Foundation
political_relevance_summary: Deliberation & Technology (DelibTech) Network addresses democratic participation and citizen engagement. International network of technologists and practitioners building and studying technology to enhance deliberation and digital infrastructure for deliberative democracy.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides technical infrastructure that other civic tools or services build upon.

generalizability_notes: Highly generalizable; already deployed across multiple countries. Proprietary or closed-source; replication requires licensing.
